extracted.intended_audience: authors, editors, publishers, students, and translators in science and related fields
extracted.subtask_description: A comprehensive style and format manual for preparing, editing, and publishing scientific manuscripts, covering editorial responsibilities, manuscript elements, technical notation, and publication practices for both print and electronic media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elements of a scientific publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on the constituent parts of scientific publications (title page, abstract, introduction, methods, results, discussion, acknowledgments, references, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers the standard components authors should include and how they function in communicating research; serves as a baseline for manuscript structure and completeness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication policies and practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and recommendations for editorial and publisher policies governing publication, including ethical and procedural practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes recommendations reflecting authoritative international bodies; relevant to journal/publisher policy design and compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsibilities of authors, editors, and peer reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Roles and ethical responsibilities for authors, editors, and peer reviewers in the process of scientific publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New chapter in this edition; covers obligations such as disclosure, authorship criteria, reviewer confidentiality, conflict-of-interest management, and conduct during peer review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright requirements and practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on copyright rules, permissions, and common practices for scientific works.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discusses requirements and practices authors and publishers must follow, including copyright transfer, licensing, and use of third-party material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alphabets, symbols, and signs
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for use of alphabets, typographic symbols, and special signs in scientific text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advises on consistent usage, encoding, and presentation of nonstandard characters and symbols.

rubrics_metrics.name: Punctuation and related marks
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and recommendations for correct punctuation in scientific prose.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers use of commas, semicolons, dashes, parentheses, colons, and other marks with examples and cautions about common errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spelling, word formation and division, plurals, and possessives
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on preferred spellings, hyphenation, plural formation, and possessive forms in scientific English.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses variant spellings (American vs British) and consistency within a document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prose style and word choice
rubrics_metrics.description: Advice on scientific prose style, clarity, concision, and appropriate vocabulary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes recommendations to improve readability, avoid jargon or ambiguous phrasing, and prefer active/clear constructions as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Names and personal designations
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for presenting author names, affiliations, degrees, and other personal designations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers ordering, formatting, use of initials, and handling of titles/honorifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for capitalization of words and phrases in scientific writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies when to use sentence case, title case, and capitalization of technical terms, organizations, and headings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Type styles, excerpts, quotations, and ellipses
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommendations for typographic styles (italic, bold, roman), handling of quotations, excerpts, and ellipses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how to present quoted material, emphasize text, and show omissions consistently and ethically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abbreviations
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidelines for creating and using abbreviations and acronyms in manuscripts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes when to define abbreviations, frequency-based use, and style for parenthetical expansions and lists of abbreviations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Numbers, units, mathematical expressions, and statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for expressing numbers, SI and other units, mathematical notation, and statistical reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers formatting of numerals vs words, unit abbreviations, significant figures, error reporting, P values, confidence intervals, and presentation of formulas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time and dates
rubrics_metrics.description: Preferred formats and conventions for writing times, dates, and durations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses international differences and advises consistent formats appropriate for the audience or journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic designations
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for presenting geographic names and place-related data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers country/region naming, administrative divisions, and consistent presentation of locations.

rubrics_metrics.name: The electromagnetic spectrum
rubrics_metrics.description: Notation and naming conventions for regions and units of the electromagnetic spectrum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides standard terminology and numeric ranges for spectral regions where relevant to scientific reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subatomic particles, chemical elements, and related notations
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for naming and symbolizing subatomic particles and chemical elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes notation, atomic symbols, isotopes, and conventions used in physics and chemistry contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chemical formulas and names
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on writing chemical formulas, systematic names, and formatting chemical information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses order of elements, subscript/superscript usage, and adherence to IUPAC conventions where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chemical kinetics and thermodynamics
rubrics_metrics.description: Conventions for reporting kinetics and thermodynamic data, units, and notation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers presentation of rate laws, equilibrium constants, energy values, units, and standard conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analytical methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for reporting analytical techniques, instrumentation, and methodological detail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes sufficient methodological detail for reproducibility, naming of instruments, and reporting limits/uncertainty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drugs and pharmacokinetics
rubrics_metrics.description: Conventions for naming drugs, reporting dosing, and pharmacokinetic parameters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes trade vs generic names, dosage units, administration routes, and standard PK metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genes, chromosomes, and related molecules
rubrics_metrics.description: Notation and naming standards for genetic elements and molecular entities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides conventions for gene symbols, protein names, sequence data, and related nomenclature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Taxonomy and nomenclature
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for biological classification names and taxonomic presentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses italicization, hierarchy levels, authority citations, and current taxonomic conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structure and function
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on describing biological structure and functional relationships in manuscripts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advises clarity in linking observed structure to inferred function and consistent terminology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disease names
rubrics_metrics.description: Conventions for naming diseases, disorders, and clinical conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers preferred terminology, eponyms, and use of standardized disease nomenclatures.

rubrics_metrics.name: The earth
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for geoscience terms, notations, and earth-related data presentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes geologic time, geographic coordinates, and earth-science specific conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Astronomical objects and time systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Conventions for naming astronomical objects and expressing astronomical time systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses epoch notation, time scales, and naming conventions relevant to astronomy papers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal style and format
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommendations for preparing manuscripts to meet journal-specific style and formatting requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Chapters provide advice pertinent to both electronic and print publication; includes guidance on adapting to individual journal instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Books, technical reports, conference proceedings, and other monographs
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for preparing longer-form scientific works and non-journal publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers front/back matter, chapter structure, citation norms for monographs, and differences from journal articles.

rubrics_metrics.name: References
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance and formats for bibliographic references and citation styles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides citation formats, ordering, punctuation, and examples; includes both American and British style variants and authoritative online resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessories to text: tables, figures, and indexes
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for preparing and presenting tables, figures, captions, and indexes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers design, labeling, numbering, legends, reproducibility of data presentation, and best practices for clarity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Typography and manuscript preparation
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical guidance on typography, layout, file preparation, and submission-ready manuscripts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes typesetting conventions, font usage, pagination, electronic file formats, and preparation tips for printers and online platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proof correction
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and best practices for proofreading and correcting proofs prior to publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advises on common proof-correction marks, how to handle corrections with publishers, and prioritizing substantive vs minor edits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coverage of both American and British styles
rubrics_metrics.description: The manual addresses conventions and differences between American and British English styles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors and editors are advised to choose and apply one style consistently; the manual provides variant recommendations for both.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of authoritative online resources
rubrics_metrics.description: The manual lists authoritative online resources relevant to style, format, and publishing practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Readers are directed to current authoritative sources for evolving standards and electronic-publication guidance.
